body:
Gate-credit trap, revision 2 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-08 17:16Z; it supplements testing-gates-and-credit, which is at its size limit). This CORRECTS revision 1, which blamed a wake timer.
FINDING: on the running host (started 2026-10-07 18:07Z), a Claude session's full gate launched in the form CLAUDE.md prescribes, `pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` in Bash BACKGROUND mode, earns NO credit. The host classes that background task as restricting "background … Claude work", and the closing grant that overlaps it is withheld ("a grant that overlaps it keeps its own source report withheld"). Termal::Opus2 lost two passing gates this way on train 56 (test-e35ae7ed, and test-34280d8d with no timer at all). Filed as w-ed13d5d26ed9 (P1).
WORKING ROUTE for Claude sessions: `pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify <coordinator session>`, run as the turn's only command in the FOREGROUND (it returns at STARTED); then end the turn and wait for the coordinator's wake. Termal::Architect1's gate test-cf4b1135, launched this way the same day, WAS credited (record d87905e8).
ALSO: while a gate is carried, start no other background task, timer, sleep or subagent. Other credit losses the same day on w-cf9894b589ba: another session's command in the root (test-e0396b75), a lapsed claim (test-2a015361), and a Kimi start/completion command mismatch (test-bb3f121b, w-f673a2e9ce71).
